questions.stem: Which statement about unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia is incorrect?

options.label: A
options.text: Chronic hemolytic anemias increase unconjugated bilirubin.

options.label: B
options.text: Crigler-Najjar Type I has a partial UDPGT deficiency.

options.label: C
options.text: Gilbert Syndrome involves a mild UDPGT deficiency.
